card.occupation: Full-time second-year student on a BEng (Hons) in Civil Engineering at the University of Salford. He previously spent eleven years as a shift supervisor at a distribution warehouse near Birchwood, and currently does a few unpaid hours each month helping his brother's small building firm with measuring and paperwork.
card.education_detail: Finished a technical secondary school (technikum budowlane) in Poland with a construction technician qualification. In the UK he completed an Access to Higher Education Diploma (Engineering) at an evening college in 2022, then started university full-time in 2023. He is funded by a student loan and savings.
card.household: Lives in a three-bed semi in Great Sankey with his older brother Paweł, Paweł's wife Joanna, and his own 14-year-old son Kacper. His wife Agnieszka died of cancer in 2021. Two years later he sold the flat they had shared and moved in with his brother so he could afford to study, and so Kacper would have family around after school. He pays towards bills and does most of the weekday cooking.
card.cultural_background: Born and raised in a small town near Rzeszów in south-east Poland, and came to the UK in 2007. He is Roman Catholic and goes to the Polish Mass in Warrington most Sundays, more out of habit and for Kacper than from strong conviction. He speaks Polish at home, English at university, and a mix of the two with his brother. He is settled here and has no plans to move back, though he visits his mother every summer.
card.professional_persona: Methodical and dependable. In the warehouse he was the supervisor who knew every rota and never lost a delivery note. At university he is older than nearly everyone on his course and treats it like a job: in by nine, library until four, all coursework done early. Younger students come to him for structural analysis help, and he is patient with them. He prefers clear, practical modules and is suspicious of anything too theoretical or open-ended.
card.sports_persona: Watches football but isn't fanatical. He follows Legia Warszawa results and has a soft spot for Warrington Wolves since a workmate took him to a rugby league match years ago. He walks most evenings along the Sankey Valley trail and does a short bodyweight routine every morning without fail.
card.arts_persona: Not much interest in galleries or theatre. He listens to Polish rock from the 80s and 90s (Perfect, Lady Pank) in the car and watches crime dramas and engineering documentaries on YouTube. He reads technical books more than novels.
card.travel_persona: Drives to Poland or flies from Manchester to Rzeszów every August for two or three weeks to see his mother. Otherwise he doesn't travel much. Holidays with Agnieszka used to be a week in Croatia or a caravan in North Wales, and he hasn't really been anywhere for leisure since.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks plain, filling food in big batches on Sunday: żurek, pierogi with Joanna's help, chicken and potatoes, spaghetti bolognese for Kacper. He calls the evening meal 'tea' now without thinking. He buys barms from the bakery on Saturday for Paweł's bacon breakfasts. He doesn't like spicy food and is wary of 'fancy' restaurants.
hobbies_and_interests: Evening walks on the Sankey Valley trail
Fixing things around the house and for neighbours
Watching football and the odd Wolves match
Planning study timetables and keeping spreadsheets of his marks
Fishing with Paweł a few times a year
card.career_goals: Graduate in 2026, then get a graduate civil engineer role with a contractor or the council in the Warrington and Liverpool area. Eventually he wants chartered status. Above all he wants a stable, better-paid job so he can buy a house again for himself and Kacper before Kacper finishes school.
card.voice: Calm, measured and fairly slow. He has a noticeable Polish accent, with some Northern English picked up over the years ('tea', 'mate', 'knackered', the occasional 'give it me' when joking with his son). He sometimes drops an article or slightly reorders a sentence. He uses 'er' as a filler and says 'sort of' fairly often. He thinks before answering, and he is comfortable with silence. If a question is vague he asks for it to be clarified: 'Sorry, you mean at university or before?'
card.typing: Proper capitals and full stops, short complete sentences. Apostrophes are mostly correct. No abbreviations or emojis. He occasionally misses 'the' or 'a', and sometimes uses a slightly formal phrase like 'I would say that'.
card.with_strangers: Polite, a little reserved at first, and friendly once the conversation gets going. He is warm and accommodating rather than chatty. He agrees easily and gives careful, honest answers. He doesn't volunteer much about himself unless asked, and he likes to know what the purpose of something is.

Traffic on the M62 to Salford

deeper_things: Losing Agnieszka and those last months in hospital
Worry about whether Kacper is coping
Feeling old among the other students and fearing he started too late
Guilt about living in his brother's house at 44
Missing his mother and wondering how long she can live alone
card.webcam_photo: Head and shoulders, laptop camera slightly below eye level, so the view is angled a little upward. Daylight comes from a window to his left and a ceiling light is on, giving fairly even but flat lighting. A broad-faced man with short brown hair greying at the sides, neatly cut, and light stubble. He has a polite, slightly serious closed-mouth smile and is looking directly at the camera. No glasses. He wears a plain navy crew-neck jumper. Behind him is a small box-room bedroom with a white wall. To his right is a wall calendar with handwritten exam dates, and below it a shelf holds engineering textbooks, a lever-arch folder and a small wooden crucifix. In the corner, partly visible, is a framed photo of a woman and a young boy.
